H5434.definition: A man of the Cushites living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.7; son of: Cush (H3568); brother of: Havilah (H2341H), Sabtah (H5454), Raamah (H7484), Sabteca (H5455) and Nimrod (H5248); § Seba = "drink thou"; 1) a son of Cush; 2) a nation south of Palestine, perhaps Ethiopia
